def literal(a,b):
 import torch
 if torch.is_tensor(a):return torch.is_tensor(b) and a.dtype==b.dtype and a.shape==b.shape and torch.equal(a.cpu(),b.cpu())
 if isinstance(a,dict):return isinstance(b,dict) and set(a)==set(b) and all(literal(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
 if isinstance(a,(tuple,list)):return type(a) is type(b) and len(a)==len(b) and all(literal(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
 return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
def json_value(x):
 import torch
 if torch.is_tensor(x):return x.detach().cpu().tolist()
 if isinstance(x,dict):return {k:json_value(v) for k,v in x.items()}

import math
from types import SimpleNamespace

def inspect_same_loaded(*,torch,mdp,wm,pi,critic,args,packed,context,frames,obs,records,unflatten_state):
    from supermimic_wheel_leg_v3.learner import SuperMimicLearner as Learner
    # This invokes the source-native imagination/reward/critic-input methods;
    # no Learner constructor, replay sampling, norm update or optimizer exists.
    native=SimpleNamespace(pi=pi,wm=wm,mdp=mdp,cfg=SimpleNamespace(goal_frames=10))
    n=len(records); rows=[];state_ids=sorted(set(k for k in (200,600,n-1) if 0<=k<n))
    def previous(k):
        return packed.new_zeros(1,6) if k==0 else torch.tensor(records[k-1]['terminal_pre_reset']['state']['executed6'],dtype=packed.dtype)[None]
    def number(t):return float(t.detach().cpu())
    for k in state_ids:
        state=list(unflatten_state(packed[k:k+1].clone()))
        p=state[0].detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
        yaw=packed.new_zeros((),requires_grad=True); c,s=torch.cos(yaw),torch.sin(yaw);z=yaw*0;one=z+1
        rotation=torch.stack((c,-s,z,s,c,z,z,z,one)).reshape(3,3)[None]
        state[0]=p;state[1]=rotation@state[1].detach()
        action=torch.tensor(records[k]['mean6'],dtype=packed.dtype)[None].clamp(-6,6)
        selected=mdp.selected_tracking_terms(tuple(state),frames[k:k+1],action,previous(k))
        parts={}
        for key,value in selected['selected_terms'].items():
            if value.requires_grad:
                gp,gy=torch.autograd.grad(value.sum(),(p,yaw),retain_graph=True,allow_unused=True)
            else:gp,gy=None,None
            parts[key]=dict(value=number(value[0]),loss_root_xyz_partial=None if gp is None else gp.detach().tolist()[0],loss_world_yaw_partial=None if gy is None else number(gy))
        gp,gy=torch.autograd.grad(selected['total'].sum(),(p,yaw),allow_unused=True)
        target,mask=mdp.provider.query(frames[k:k+1]);loss=number(selected['tracking_loss'][0]);deficit=parts['terminal_history_deficit']['value'];dense=loss-deficit
        rows.append(dict(input_control=k+1,public_age=k,teacher_phase=int(mdp.provider.phase_at(frames[k:k+1])[0]),actual_root_xyz=p.detach().tolist()[0],target_root_xyz=target[0,:3].tolist(),goal_root_mask=mask[0,:13].tolist(),reward=number(selected['total'][0]),loss=loss,terms=parts,reward_root_xyz_partial=None if gp is None else gp.detach().tolist()[0],reward_world_yaw_partial=None if gy is None else number(gy),shared_reciprocal_gradient_factor=.2/(1+loss)**2,constant_history_deficit=deficit,gradient_fraction_vs_same_dense_loss_without_constant_deficit=(1+dense)**2/(1+loss)**2,state_partial_not_action_or_policy_gradient=True))
    parameter_flags=[p.requires_grad for p in pi.parameters()]
    for p in pi.parameters():p.requires_grad_(True)
    parameters=tuple(pi.parameters()); gradient_rows=[]
    try:
        for k in (200,600):
            if k>=n:
                gradient_rows.append(dict(input_control=k+1,status='NOT_AVAILABLE_ORIGINAL_CASE_ENDED_EARLIER'));continue
            state=unflatten_state(packed[k:k+1].clone());ctx=context[k:k+1].clone();normal=mdp.normalize_context(ctx);f=frames[k:k+1].clone()

            for _ in range(32):
                previous_actions.append(prev)
                state,prev,history,f,goal=Learner._imag_step(native,state,history,prev,f,ctx,normal,goal)
                if first_action is None:first_action=prev
                states.append(state);actions.append(prev);future_frames.append(f)
            flat=lambda xs:torch.stack(xs).flatten(0,1)
            allstates=tuple(flat([x[j] for x in states]) for j in range(7))
            reward,done=Learner._reward_term(native,allstates,flat(future_frames),flat(actions),flat(previous_actions))
            reward=reward.view(32,1);done=done.view(32,1);alive=torch.cumprod(1-done,0);continuation=torch.cat((torch.ones_like(alive[:1]),alive[:-1]),0)

            v=critic(Learner._critic_input(native,state,f,normal,goal)).reshape(1); survival=alive[-1]
            full=(discount*continuation*reward).sum()+args['gamma']**32*(survival*v).sum()
            terms=dict(reward_loss=(discount*continuation.detach()*reward).sum(),reward_continuation=(discount*continuation*reward.detach()).sum(),terminal_value=args['gamma']**32*(survival.detach()*v).sum(),terminal_survival=args['gamma']**32*(survival*v.detach()).sum(),full_native_objective=full)
            vectors={};stats={}
            for name,value in terms.items():

                vector=torch.cat([(torch.zeros_like(p) if g is None else g).reshape(-1) for p,g in zip(parameters,derivatives[:-1])]).detach()

            combined=sum(vectors[name] for name in ('reward_loss','reward_continuation','terminal_value','terminal_survival'));fullv=vectors['full_native_objective']
            error=number((combined-fullv).norm());scale=max(number(fullv.norm()),1e-12)
            assert error/scale<2e-3 or error<1e-7,(error,scale)
            for name,vec in vectors.items():
                denom=vec.norm()*fullv.norm();stats[name]['cosine_to_full_Pi_gradient']=None if number(denom)==0 else number(torch.dot(vec,fullv)/denom)
            gradient_rows.append(dict(input_control=k+1,public_age=k,native_H=32,gamma=args['gamma'],initial_action6=first_action.detach().tolist()[0],first_action_CPU_vs_saved_GPU_max_abs=number((first_action.detach()-torch.tensor(records[k]['mean6'],dtype=packed.dtype)[None].clamp(-6,6)).abs().max()),predicted_hard_stop_count=int((done>=.99).sum()),predicted_terminal_survival=number(survival[0]),terminal_critic_value=number(v[0]),reward_sum=number(reward.sum()),product_rule_parts=stats,product_rule_gradient_sum_error_L2=error,relative_sum_error=error/scale,model_conditional_not_physical_gradient_truth=True))
    finally:
        for p,flag in zip(pi.parameters(),parameter_flags):p.requires_grad_(flag)
    return dict(schema='mod4.new180.same_loaded_actual_case_layered_gradients.v1',state_partials=rows,native_policy_gradients=gradient_rows,source_native_methods=['Learner._imag_step','Learner._reward_term','Learner._critic_input'],source_args_H32_confirmed=True,no_Learner_or_optimizer_constructed=True,no_model_raw_reference_reread=True,no_norm_or_parameter_update=True,no_actual_action_acceleration_causality_proved=True,scope='Up to3 deterministic actual-state partials and2 fixed same-model H32 policy-gradient decompositions; not population or unique root-cause proof')
